it-feels-like-a-lot.title: It feels like a lot
it-feels-like-a-lot.keywords: four disciplines, a day-one note every time, the work that moved
it-feels-like-a-lot.script: I know. It sounds like a lot. Four disciplines, a day-one note every single time. I will not pretend it is not work. It is. It is the work that moved.
